Context brief (what every draft reads first)
Apex Manufacturing (8,200 employees, two Indian legal entities, unionised plant workforce) is replacing a homegrown HR system and spreadsheets with an integrated HRMS. The components business will be demerged next financial year, so entity moves, separate payroll calendars and harmonised compensation structures matter. Priorities: single employee master, Indian statutory payroll for both entities, biometric and geo-fenced attendance, digital payroll inputs, and a strong change-management workstream. Finance runs Hyperion; SSO is Microsoft Entra ID.

Confirming locks the question list. Drafting starts from the workspace.

Mandate & vision

2· Why now, what success looks like, whose mandate this is
  1. 1

    What has to be true a year after go-live for you to call this programme a success — and which of those outcomes will the board look at first?

    Every answer we drafted is about capability; none of the RFP says how success will be judged.

  2. 2

    The demerger and the HRMS replacement land in the same year. Which one sets the timeline if they collide?

    A.3 is only partially answerable until the demerger sequence is known.

Scope & structure

2· Entities, geographies, headcount, what is in and out
  1. 1

    After the demerger, will Apex Components run its own HR team and policies, or share a group HR function with Apex Industries?

    Shapes the entity model, approval chains and payroll calendars in sections A and B.

  2. 2

    Are any international entities or expatriate payrolls in scope for the next three years?

    The RFP names two Indian entities only.

Operating model

1· HR operating model, shared services, roles after go-live
  1. 1

    Who owns employee data after go-live — HR operations, the business units, or a central shared-services team?

    D.3 makes Darwinbox the source of truth, which needs a named data owner.

Technology & AI

2· Current systems, integrations, data, appetite for AI
  1. 1

    How do you want the Hyperion integration to behave: a monthly file your finance team reconciles, or a live feed?

    B.6 is compliant via customisation; the data contract is still an open point.

  2. 2

    How much should managers rely on AI-surfaced insights like attrition risk, and who decides what they can see?

    D.4 needs an agreed insight set and RBAC scope.

Prioritisation

1· What must land first, trade-offs, phasing
  1. 1

    If only three modules could go live on day one, which three would you choose?

    24 requirements, 15 marked Must Have; phasing is not stated.

Governance & culture

2· Sponsorship, decision rights, change readiness, unions
  1. 1

    How will the unions at each plant be brought into decisions on attendance capture and overtime rules?

    C.4 depends on plant-wise union agreements we have not seen.

  2. 2

    Who signs off on harmonised salary structures across both entities, and how will you explain the changes to employees?

    B.3 standardises CTC components — a change that needs a sponsor.

Knowledge base

Darwinbox capabilities, Kognoz services, approved answers and their sources — what every draft is allowed to cite.

Darwinbox capabilities36Kognoz services7Approved answers12Sources3
/
36 capabilities

Core HR

4
  • Employee master and custom fields

    Darwinbox maintains a single employee master with standard fields for personal, employment, position, cost-centre and statutory data. Custom fields and custom sections can be added per entity or globally without code, with field-level visibility and edit permissions by role. Effective-dated changes keep a full history of every field.

    employee mastercustom fieldseffective datingStandard3 days ago
  • Organisation structure and position management

    Organisation structure is modelled as configurable hierarchies (entity, business unit, department, sub-department, location, cost centre) with position management: positions carry grade, band, reporting line and headcount budget, and can be vacant or filled. Multiple legal entities and group companies run on one instance with entity-specific policies, letter templates and approval chains.

    org structurepositionsmulti-entityStandardlast week
  • Configurable workflows and approvals

    Every transaction (data change, transfer, promotion, separation, leave, expense) runs through a configurable multi-level workflow builder with conditional routing by entity, grade, location or amount, parallel and sequential approvers, delegation, escalation timers and audit trail.

    workflowapprovalsaudit trailStandard2 weeks ago
  • Letter generation and document management

    HR letters (offer, appointment, confirmation, transfer, increment, relieving) are generated from templates with merge fields and can be routed for digital signature. Employee documents are stored against the profile with categories, expiry tracking and role-based access.

    lettersdocumentse-signStandardyesterday

Helpdesk

1
  • Policy repository and HR helpdesk

    Policies are published in a searchable repository with version control and acknowledgement tracking. The HR helpdesk module provides ticket categories, SLAs, assignment rules and dashboards, and employees can raise queries from web or mobile.

    policieshelpdeskcase managementStandard5 days ago

Payroll

5
  • India payroll with statutory compliance

    Darwinbox Payroll processes Indian payroll end to end: salary structures with configurable components, arrears, loans and advances, reimbursements, income-tax computation with investment declarations and proofs, PF, ESI, professional tax, LWF, TDS returns and Form 16 generation. Bank advice files and statutory reports are produced per entity.

    payrollPFESI+2Standard2 weeks ago
  • Multi-entity, multi-cycle payroll

    Payroll can run per legal entity with separate calendars, pay cycles, components and statutory registrations, and a group-level view for consolidated cost reporting. Inputs flow from attendance, leave, expenses and one-time payments through maker–checker review before processing.

    multi-entitypay cyclesmaker checkerStandard3 days ago
  • Digital payroll inputs and one-off payments

    One-off payments (joining bonus, retention bonus, incentives, recoveries) are captured as payroll input types with configurable approval workflows, eligibility rules and effective periods, replacing spreadsheet inputs. Bulk upload templates with validation remain available for high-volume inputs.

    payroll inputsone-off paymentsbulk uploadStandardlast week
  • Full and final settlement

    Full and final settlement is triggered from the separation workflow: it computes final salary, leave encashment, notice-period recovery, gratuity eligibility and pending reimbursements, with a settlement statement for the employee and accounting output.

    F&Fseparationleave encashmentStandard2 weeks ago
  • Payroll outside India

    Native payroll is available for India and selected APAC/Middle East countries; for other countries Darwinbox integrates with local payroll providers through standard payroll-output interfaces. Country coverage must be confirmed per RFP.

    global payrollpayroll integrationConfigurableyesterday

Time & attendance

2
  • Attendance capture: biometric, mobile, geo-fenced

    Attendance can be captured from biometric devices (device or database integration), web check-in, and the mobile app with geo-fencing, selfie/face verification and offline sync. Shift schedules, rosters, overtime rules, grace periods and regularisation workflows are configurable per location or employee group.

    biometricgeo-fencingshifts+1Standard5 days ago
  • Attendance, working-day and LOP reporting

    Standard reports cover attendance summary, actual working days, loss of pay, late/early marks and overtime by date range, employee, department or location, exportable to Excel and schedulable. The report builder allows additional custom views on the same data.

    LOPreportsworking daysStandard2 weeks ago

Deal context

Apex Manufacturing (8,200 employees, two Indian legal entities, unionised plant workforce) is replacing a homegrown HR system and spreadsheets with an integrated HRMS. The components business will be demerged next financial year, so entity moves, separate payroll calendars and harmonised compensation structures matter. Priorities: single employee master, Indian statutory payroll for both entities, biometric and geo-fenced attendance, digital payroll inputs, and a strong change-management workstream. Finance runs Hyperion; SSO is Microsoft Entra ID.

1 question still undrafted

Draft them all at once, or one at a time from each card below. Remove any that should not be answered.

Q1

Can one-off payments like joining and retention bonuses go through an approval before payroll picks them up?

ApprovedFully0.90

Fully compliant. One-off payments are captured as payroll input types with eligibility rules, approval workflows and effective periods; inputs pass maker–checker review before processing [1].

  1. [1] Digital payroll inputs and one-off payments
v1 · 2 hours ago
Q2

How does the system handle separate pay calendars when the components business is demerged?

AI draftFully0.86

Fully compliant. Payroll runs per legal entity with its own calendar, components and statutory registrations [1]; employees and positions move between entities on an effective date, with the receiving entity’s policies applying from that date [2].

  1. [1] Multi-entity, multi-cycle payroll
  2. [2] Organisation structure and position management
v1 · 2 hours ago
Q3

Can plant supervisors approve overtime from the mobile app, with rules that differ by plant?

AI draftPartial0.61

Partially compliant. Overtime rules, shift schedules and grace periods are configurable per location or employee group, and approvals run from web and mobile [1]. Plant-specific union rules must be documented during design [2].

Open points
  • Collect plant-wise union agreements for overtime and allowances
  1. [1] Attendance capture: biometric, mobile, geo-fenced
  2. [2] Darwinbox Studio (low-code extensions)
v1 · 2 hours ago
Q4

Is there a standard integration with Hyperion for bonus accruals?

Not drafted
